about: Every inline suppression is a site keyed by the tool and rule it names: eslint- and oxlint-disable (oxlint honours both), ast-grep-ignore, production @ts-expect-error and Rust #[expect]; a directive naming no rule, @ts-ignore and @ts-nocheck are refused; strings, templates, regex literals, prose and eslint-enable are none; a test's @ts-expect-error is exempt (2.1-M187)
